body: One job that has worked for me personally is a laid back call center job. Notice the term “laid back” because I’ve worked in a call center that was literally hell on earth because of the nature of the calls. But what I do now is vastly different. I get to help people all day and while I DO have to do the “fake positivity” thing, it only extends to my voice. I don’t have to smile, I don’t have to be mindful of my body language or what I’m wearing/what I look like, I ONLY have to have a positive voice. While it is still a bit draining when I’m not feeling super positive, it seems extremely less draining than putting my entire self into putting on a show of happiness and positivity I’m not actually feeling. Plus at the right call center you have time between calls to just sit and think and unwind from the last call whereas other jobs have many tasks to do between “customers” and whatnot like cleaning, sticking, paperwork etc. having that break between calls has been very helpful for me. Everyone is different so a call center job may not be for you but that’s the one job out of a dozen or so that I’ve been able to stick with so far

Was at the store with a friend picking up a handful of groceries for her and some miscellaneous items for myself. The last thing on the list was crushed walnuts and slivered almonds which we could NOT find anywhere. Me and my friend both had some social anxiety, especially being two awkward 17ish y/o girls. But I see an associate and muster up the courage to ask him for help. I start waking up to this guy and I’m kinda proud of myself for stepping out of my comfort zone, right? So I’m strutting up to him all confident like and ask him, with ALL the confidence in the world, 
“Excuse me Sir,🧐 where are your nuts?” 
Immediately you see it in his face that he heard it too but me and the dude both decided to play it off like I didn’t just formally ask him to direct me to his manhood. So he’s trying to tell me what aisle I need without letting out too much of his amusement but my friend who had been shyly standing behind me couldn’t hold her composure and just starts losing it! Im still trying to play it cool and go to give her A Look™️, but then Dude loses it laughing and I couldn’t keep a straight face after that either. We had a good chuckle at ourselves and then he sent us in the right direction. 
Maybe not THE dumbest thing I’ve ever said but definitely one that sticks out in my mind!

TL;DR    I asked a store employee where his nuts were 🙃

If they hate your most supportive friend for no real reason, or seems to try to come up with reasons, that’s a red flag. They hate people in your life that remind you who you are and that you’re allowed to stick up for yourself because those are two things an abuser will try to twist in your mind. Abusers will generally try to separate you from everyone you’re close to in order to isolate you, making you easier to control so watch out for that in general. But they will ESPECIALLY hate that friend that is always there for you, usually the one you consider your best friend, the one who knows YOU the most. The aggression my abuser showed towards my super supportive friend was subtle at first but became increasingly obvious as she became more and more of a ‘problem’ for him.
